doc.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth, parents and siblings
summary: Tyner gives his birth name and date, his parents' North Carolina roots, his father's job and his brother Jarvis and sister Gwen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born Alfred McCoy Tyner and I was born December 11, 1938.
OK, now could you give us your parents’ names?
OK, my mother’s name was Beatrice Tyner and my fathers name is Jarvis Tyner.

My father worked in a company that made medicated cream. As a matter of fact, I got a job there. His boss got to know me and my father said, “Ah, let him come in on Saturday.” And then I was putting the medication stuff in the jars (laughs) with the machine, it was nice, an actual job. I could go to the movies. It was really nice growing up in Philadelphia during that time period.
And do you know where your parents were originally from? Were they original Philadelphians?
No, they were born in North Carolina, Murfreesboro, North Carolina, yeah.
As far as I know. Both of them were born there, yeah.
And in reading your biography, you’re the oldest of three children?
So there were four of you, you had three siblings?
Oh, two, I’m sorry my facts aren’t . . . too clear (laughs). That’s right two. Two boys and one sister Gwen, yeah I forgot.
So there were three children total or four children total? Three children total. You’re the oldest, and who was the next?
Your brother, and what was his name?
He was named after my father.
